## Personality

Bentley is an old minister. He is characterized by a notable lack of imagination.

## History

Bentley was a widower during his time in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), where he served as the village minister for eighteen years. [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) famously found him to be lacking in imagination during his tenure. He was eventually succeeded as minister by Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md).
